title: Bram and the Drop
author: Emrys Yarrow
blurb: Ada Okafor, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
